clips.title: The story
paras: The Broken Construct involves aiding an artisan in Valanaar who is struggling to repair a rare, damaged automaton. These machines were originally gifted by the departed spirits of the wind and preserved by the Windshapers, making every remaining functional construct an invaluable relic of the island's past.

Long ago, the spirits of the wind bestowed magical instruments, devices, and animated constructs upon the people of the island. The Windshapers were tasked with their upkeep, preserving these elemental gifts across generations. However, after the spirits left, the flow of their ancient patronage ceased, causing most of the wondrous creations to fall into disrepair until only a handful remained operational.

Within the city of Valanaar, one of the last functioning constructs recently suffered damage, threatening to reduce the island's dwindling heritage even further. An artisan named Riaani Nightwind was sent to the western edge of the city to examine the machine and attempt repairs, though the fragile nature of these ancient devices makes additional aid essential.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Historically, the Windshapers have seen to the tending of the magical instruments and devices that were gifted to us by the spirits of the wind. This includes the myriad of magical constructs around the island. Since the spirits left us, only a scant few of these are still functional.

One of the few remaining working constructs in Valanaar has become damaged. One of our artisans was dispatched to help, but he may be in need of aid. Travel to the west end of the city and offer any assistance you can.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Riaani's face is buried under the heaving armor plates of the construct, attempting to work on the mechanisms underneath. He does not notice your presence at all.
Storms curse--where is the core?! Who thought it would be a good idea to remove the Gyrozephyr as well? It's a miracle this construct's winds haven't dissipated entirely by now!
